name: getSettings
description: Shows the plugin's settings, design and introduction screen options.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are read.

error.description: Why they couldn't be read, if they couldn't.

result.description: The settings, as they are now.

followingEnabled.description: Whether app users can follow locations to hear about updates.

allowCustomNotifications.description: Whether location editors can send notifications to a location's followers.

defaultSorting.description: How locations are sorted at first.

hideSorting.description: Whether app users are kept from changing the sorting.

allowSortByReverseAlphabetical.description: Whether app users can sort from Z to A.

allowSortByNearest.description: Whether app users can sort by distance; turning it off makes locations sort by name at first.

allowSortByPriceLowToHigh.description: Whether app users can sort from cheapest.

allowSortByPriceHighToLow.description: Whether app users can sort from priciest.

allowSortByDate.description: Whether app users can sort from newest.

allowSortByRating.description: Whether app users can sort by rating.

allowSortByViews.description: Whether app users can sort by views.

allowFilterByArea.description: Whether app users can show only the area on the map.

allowFilterByBookmarks.description: Whether app users can show only their bookmarked locations.

hideOpeningHoursFilter.description: Whether the open now choice is hidden.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price choice is hidden.

showInitialArea.description: Whether the map opens on a chosen area.

initialAreaAddress.description: The address of the area the map opens on.

initialAreaLatitude.description: Where the map opens, north to south, from -90 to 90.

initialAreaLongitude.description: Where the map opens, east to west, from -180 to 180.

bookmarksEnabled.description: Whether app users can bookmark at all.

allowBookmarkLocations.description: Whether app users can bookmark locations.

allowBookmarkSearches.description: Whether app users can bookmark their searches.

allowOpeningHours.description: Whether locations have opening hours; turning it off stops app users adding them.

allowPriceRange.description: Whether locations have a price range; turning it off stops app users adding one.

listViewPosition.description: How far the list of locations opens over the map.

listViewStyle.description: How locations look in the list.

defaultMapType.description: How the map looks at first.

enableMapTerrainView.description: Whether the map can show terrain.

hideQuickFilter.description: Whether the category chips above the map are hidden.

allowMapStyleSelection.description: Whether app users can switch the map style.

showDetailsCategory.description: Whether a location's page shows its category and subcategory.

showContributorName.description: Whether a location's page shows who added it.

detailsMapPosition.description: Where the map sits on a location's page.

introDescription.description: The formatted text on the introduction screen, as HTML.

introSorting.description: How the introduction screen sorts its locations.

introLocationsSource.description: Which locations the introduction screen shows.

introAreaAddress.description: The address at the center of the local area the introduction screen shows.

introAreaLatitude.description: The center of the local area, north to south, from -90 to 90.

introAreaLongitude.description: The center of the local area, east to west, from -180 to 180.

introAreaRadius.description: How far around its center the local area reaches, from 1 to 200 miles.

introImages.description: The pictures at the top of the introduction screen, in order, each with its picture and what tapping it does. Replaces the current pictures.

locationFields.description: The extra fields every location can fill in, in order.

type.description: What the field holds: EMAIL, PHONE, URL, TEXT or RICH_TEXT.

section.description: Where it shows: quickActions or content.

required.description: Whether every location must fill it in.

allowCustomLabel.description: Whether each location may give it its own label.
